data.name: Ibrahem
data.gender_notes: Ibrahem is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ibrahem is the Arabic form of Abraham, meaning 'father of many nations'. He is a revered prophet in Islam. The name Ibrahem carries the meaning “Father of many nations” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ibrahem usually hope their child will grow to embody father of many nations and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, Ibrahem is considered a righteous prophet and a model of faith, known for his unwavering devotion to Allah.
data.etymology: Ibrahem belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of many nations.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibrahem total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: إبراهيم
in_arabic.meaning: أبو الأنبياء، خليل الله، اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي
in_arabic.long_meaning: إبراهيم هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، وهو اسم نبي الله إبراهيم عليه السلام، ويعني في اللغة العربية 'أبو الأنبياء' أو 'خليل الله'، وهو من الأسماء المحترمة في الإسلام التي تذكر في القرآن الكريم، ويحمل هذا الاسم تاريخًا عظيمًا في الديانة الإسلامية واليهودية والمسيحية.

in_urdu.name: ابراہیم
in_urdu.meaning: پیغمبر اعظم، خلیل اللہ، ابو الانبیاء
in_urdu.long_meaning: ابراہیم ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، یہ نام اللہ کے نبی ابراہیم کے نام سے منسوب ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے 'پیغمبر اعظم' یا 'خلیل اللہ'، یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں بہت احترام کے ساتھ ذکر کیا جاتا ہے، خاص طور پر قرآن مجید میں، اور اسلامی، یہودی، اور مسیحی تقالید میں اس کا بڑا تاریخی اور روحانی اہمیت ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इब्राहिम
in_hindi.meaning: पैगंबर इब्राहिम, भगवान का मित्र, महान पैगंबर
in_hindi.long_meaning: इब्राहिम एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, यह अल्लाह के पैगंबर इब्राहिम का नाम है, जिसका अर्थ है 'पैगंबर इब्राहिम' या 'भगवान का मित्र', यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत सम्मान के साथ प्रयोग किया जाता है, खासकर कुरआन में, और इसकी जड़ें इस्लामी, यहूदी और ईसाई परंपराओं में हैं।

in_pashto.name: ابراهيم
in_pashto.meaning: د خدای پیغمبر، د خدای دوست، ابراهيم
in_pashto.long_meaning: ابراهيم د يو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبې څخه اخستل شوی دی، دا د الله تعالی د پیغمبر ابراهيم نوم دی، چی معنی یی دی 'د خدای پیغمبر' یا 'د خدای دوست'، دا نوم د اسلامي دود په کی د ډیر احترام سره ذکر کیږي، خاصه په قرآن کریم کی، او دا د اسلامي، یهودي، او مسيحي دودونو په کی د پام وړ تاريخي او روحاني ارزښت لري.

in_english.name: Ibrahem
in_english.meaning: Father of nations, friend of God, prophet
in_english.long_meaning: Ibrahem is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, derived from the name of the Prophet Ibrahim, who is considered a significant figure in Islam, Judaism, and Christianity. The name means 'father of nations' or 'friend of God'. In Islamic tradition, Ibrahem is a highly respected name, mentioned in the Quran, and symbolizes spiritual leadership, prophethood, and divine friendship.

data.cultural_impact: Ibrahem is a significant figure in Islamic history and culture, as he is regarded as one of the major prophets in Islam. He is the father of Prophet Ismail and Grandfather of Prophet Ishaque, making him the ancestor of millions of Muslims today. Ibrahem's life and teachings have elicited deep reverence among Muslims, inspiring generations to hold steadfast to their faith and follow God's commandments.
data.spiritual_significance: Ibrahem is considered a model of submission and obedience to God in Islam. His good deeds and unwavering faith serve as a source of inspiration for believers. His willingness to sacrifice his only son, Ismail, at God's command, demonstrates the importance of submitting to God's will above all else, a concept central to Islam. This act, called the 'Sakrah of Ibrahem', represents the supreme act of a believer acknowledging that everything belongs to God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Father of many nations" symbolizes Ibrahem is the Arabic form of Abraham, meaning 'father of many nations'. He is a revered prophet in Islam.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Ibrahem serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of father of many nations.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Ibrahem is mentioned in the 13th century book 'Kitab al-Aghani' The name Ibrahem carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Ibrahem was used in the medieval Arabic literature

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Ibrahem remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
